meta.title: Independent mechanics and energy calculations
meta.scope: Package3 only; main checkout read-only. All calculations standalone, no prototype measurements.
meta.units: mm,N,MPa for beam; mA*V=mW; uA*V=uW; mAh*V/1000=Wh

omron_direction.basis: Press pin plungers in their operating direction; avoid improper side force.

omron_optical.basis: Electrical-characteristic test conditions: 5 mA, 30 us on / 970 us off; VF typical 1.16 V. Search-index text verified; PDF direct open did not expose readable text.

ti3001.basis: p5 electrical table and pp18,22-23 wake policy. Low current depends on sampling interval; not a selected component.

pyrofil.basis: PP-C-20A typical density1.01g/cm3,flexural modulus13500MPa,tensile120MPa,flexural210MPa. Typical, not guaranteed or mold-specific.

beam.basis: Beam displacement theory. Calculation here derives simply-supported rectangular-beam formulas independently.

beam_stress.basis: Beam bending stress and section properties.

ruler.basis: Ruler rotated through its two bending axes.

direct_drive.label: derived ideal local projection, not Theseus performance
direct_drive.component_rule: Axial and lateral components are perpendicular;cos(theta)^2+sin(theta)^2=1.94% axial and34% lateral do not sum to128% energy or imply34% wasted work.

constant_speed.assumptions: Equal axial actuation travel d; equal trigger-path speed v; locally constant20deg tangent; no compliance, clearance or friction change.

constant_force_acceleration.assumptions: Separate ideal model: same axial effective mass/travel, zero initial speed, constant force, zero resistance.

direct_drive.boundary: Force and prescribed-motion models are alternatives, not simultaneous proof. A real arc changes angle through travel. No reaction-time, force-feel, wear-life or press-to-PC result follows without a matched test.

optical.label: hypothetical pulse/energy examples only; NOT measured Razer switch share

inherited_cross_device_example.capacity_status: Inherited secondary-review306mAh value; not independently confirmed maker capacity here.
inherited_cross_device_example.warning: 0.30mA LED rail divided by1.70mA battery current is invalid without rail voltage and losses; schedule not proven deployed by Razer.

optical.led_die_power_boundary: 5mA test VF1.16V applies to LED die only, excluding drive resistor/transistor/receiver/regulator/MCU. Not the battery branch power.
optical.replacement_formula: T_new/T_old=P_old/(P_old-P_old_branch+P_new_branch), same usable battery energy and workload
optical.almost_half_claim: F31.1: Razer staff online via Brock; no public quotation identified in supplied evidence or this targeted pass. Unverified attribution, not a measurement.
optical.saleable: Mechanical clicks need no light emitter. Magnetic scrolling removes the optical path. Measure the complete design before promising a runtime multiplier.

hall.label: component examples, not selected Theseus encoder

tmag5253.detection_wait_assumption: Wait statistics assume a persistent step, ideal periodic point sampling and uniform event phase. Transient movement/reversal can be missed entirely; the maximum is not a guarantee that every scroll is detected.
tmag5253.table_model_difference: 90.5uA is TI's estimate, not2mA*50us/(1ms+50us). It is numerically consistent withabout1.9mA pulses. Do not label it a derived2mA result or infer the part variant from the table.50us high is not50us valid measurement; startup/settling/ADC must fit.

tmag3001_datasheet_examples.warning: Homepage0.45uA wake/sleep is not an interval-independent scroll-current budget.0.45mA standby is a different state.

quadrature_sampling_example.label: invented acceptance-design example, not Theseus wheel specification
quadrature_sampling_example.boundary: Sampling each quadrature state needs worst-case sample gap below the shortest transition dwell, with margin for speed variation/noise.1.05ms already exceeds this1.0417ms dwell. Absolute-angle decoding has different wrapping/alias rules; no universal safe interval is established.

wake_policy: During play, use a validated scan/conversion interval and count energy for all channels, ADC, MCU wakeups, I2C, regulator quiescent current/losses and pullups.
For idle, retain an autonomous magnetic wake detector or periodic conversions. A shutdown-only analog sensor cannot detect a wheel movement to wake itself.
Wake-on-mouse-motion alone loses the first scroll when the mouse is stationary. Test the first notch, fast reversal, multiple turns and scroll-only wake from every sleep state.
Transition to the fast state after wake and preserve the first event/direction; count duty timeout and rearming energy. Timer/threshold interrupt is not continuous capture.

explicit_session_energy_example.label: invented8h active/16h idle schedule; two2mA sensors at1.8V,90%conversion; excludes host/ADC
explicit_session_energy_example.boundary: Energy of this assumed schedule, not mouse endurance. Always awake Hall can cost more than a pulsed optical implementation; actual selected parts and firmware decide.

same_capacity_batteries.label: two maker examples, matched nominal voltage/capacity, not selected Theseus packs

pouch.boundary: bare battery with solder tabs; PCM/NTC/lead/connector/mount absent

cylinder.boundary: approx cell mass; protection and terminations not specified

same_capacity_batteries.boundary: Li-polymer pouch is also lithium-ion. Different formats/makers/minimum capacities; no matched discharge/cycle/abuse/finished-pack test. Capacity does not establish mouse runtime.

mechanics.label: analytical teaching models; no validated whole-shell strength or lifetime

beam_rotation.boundary: Simply supported, central point load, constant scalar E, small-deflection beam model.10N is a stated example, not measured gaming grip. Deep orientation L/h=6: shear/3D effects deserve checking before calling9.18x an accurate physical test prediction.

index_rules.axial_tie_stiffness: For fixed L, axial k=EA/L and mass=rho*A*L: maximizeE/rho.
index_rules.axial_tie_strength: For matching failure criterion, axial capacity/mass ranks asstrength/rho.
index_rules.fixed_width_bending_stiffness: At fixed L,b,m: h=m/(rho*b*L); k proportionalE/rho^3. Minimum mass at a stiffness target maximizesE^(1/3)/rho. Index ratio must be cubed for equal-mass stiffness ratio.
index_rules.plate_bending_stiffness: Isotropic D=E*t^3/[12*(1-nu^2)]; thickness-free mass index=[E/(1-nu^2)]^(1/3)/rho. Omittingnu is an explicit approximation; laminates need directional stiffness.
index_rules.fixed_width_bending_strength: M_limit=strength*b*h^2/6; at fixed mass ranks asstrength/rho^2. Minimum mass at same allowable moment maximizes sqrt(strength)/rho.
index_rules.geometrically_scaled_beam: If width and depth both scale at fixed aspect ratio, useE^(1/2)/rho for stiffness-limited minimum mass, notE^(1/3)/rho.

pp_vs_mg_from_inherited_inputs.boundary: This comparison isolates inherited scalar material values. It is not a molded-shell proof, matched yield ranking, buckling prediction or procurement recommendation.

fr4_vs_mg_axial_tie_from_inherited_input.boundary: The0.437 ratio uses FR4's20GPa flexural modulus as a scalar axial-modulus proxy, not a measured tensile modulus. This conditional model can have higher tensile-strength/mass and lower axial-stiffness/mass simultaneously. Coupon data is not populated-PCB capacity; cutouts,copper,attachments,layup and load direction matter.

mechanics.triangle_boundary: A nondegenerate planar pin-jointed triangle removes the square's in-plane shear mechanism. For a free planar frame, Maxwellb-2j+3=s-m, with self-stress states s and internal infinitesimal mechanisms m. Equality to zero is necessary for an isostatic candidate, not for every rigid frame, and does not alone prove rigidity. A rigid redundant frame may have b>2j-3. Real shell members can bend,buckle,twist or fail at joints.
mechanics.strength_boundary: E is not strength; deflection is not failure.120MPa is a stipulated scalar tensile threshold, not a multiaxial short-fiber damage model. Coupon direction, flow/weld lines,impact,fatigue,creep,buckling,minimum walls and attachments can control. Inherited shell FEA was not rerun or independently validated here.
